qualification: Pre-fix fvid_media::owned_mp4::Mp4Reader silently skipped QuickTime version-1 mp4a audio tracks (44-byte SoundDescription v1 header), causing audio-only QuickTime v1 MOV files to fail with 'MP4 has no track in a codec this reader plays', muxed video+audio QuickTime v1 MOV files to lose their audio stream in probe_mp4, decode_mp4_aac_pcm, and owned_mp4_remux, and QuickTime v0/v2 MOV files nesting esds inside wave to fail with 'missing MP4 esds box'. Pre-fix baseline reproduced all defects and the forced acceptance test failed.
Updating crates/fvid-media/src/owned_mp4_impl.rs admits mp4a version 1 with a 44-byte header check and resolves esds inside wave when not directly in the sample entry child list.

All 6 healthy ISO/QuickTime v0/v1/v2 direct and wave/esds controls decode 3,072 mono 48 kHz float32 samples matching the independent analytical IMDCT + overlap-add reference within 1e-6, expose identical audio metadata in probe_mp4, support interval decoding ([1024..2048]), memory budget admission, Matroska remuxing, and player AudioStream seek/rewind/EOF, while all 3 malformed inputs (truncated 40-byte v1 header, wave without esds, direct without esds) refuse cleanly as Error::Invalid.

4 focused tests, 99 related MP4/AAC/HLS/VP9 integration tests, 15 fvid-media owned_mp4 unit tests, 44 minimal-configuration (--no-default-features) tests, offline fixture unittest, and full player build pass.

Apple QuickTime File Format Sound Sample Description v1 and wave/esds extensions and ISO/IEC 14496-14 govern mp4a sample entries. All fixtures are pure synthetic offline AAC-LC/VP9 MP4/MOV files requiring neither FFmpeg nor network access.
counting: One QuickTime mp4a version-1 and wave/esds sample description support fix in fvid_media::owned_mp4 (FVID-0186). No extra IDs for individual fixture variants or controls.
